intro: Three tones, one calming whole. Upmods Trio’s colour-blocked headboard and soft finish bring visual balance and deep storage below hide the mess without hiding the style.

features.title: A headboard with quiet boldness
features.text: The cushioned, colour-blocked headboard features three calming tones that add depth and softness — a modern statement that doesn’t overpower your space.

features.title: Strength that shows up silently
features.text: Crafted from engineered wood, the frame brings everyday durability in a clean, minimalist form — strong enough to hold up through the rhythms of daily life.

features.title: Clutter gone in one gentle lift
features.text: Box storage beneath opens with ease, offering generous space for everything you want tucked away — keeping your room clear and your head even clearer. Plus, all Upmods beds come with versatile storage options to suit your unique lifestyle.

features.title: A finish that invites stillness
features.text: The matte wood texture softens the look and feel of your space, reflecting a quiet luxury that turns your bed into a daily place of rest and reset.

features.title: A ledge that lives with you
features.text: The display ledge offers a space for books, décor, or the small things that make a room yours — a functional surface designed with care and clarity.

name: Upmods Trio Queen Size Engineered Wood Bed With Box Storage
